say: Driving instructors, welcome to The Motoring Central. This is how it works, and what's in it for you.
cap: Driving instructors, welcome to The Motoring Central. This is how it works, and what's in it for you.

say: It starts with a learner looking for lessons near them. They enter their postcode, choose manual or automatic, and say whether they'd prefer a male or a female instructor.
cap: It starts with a learner looking for lessons near them. They enter their postcode, choose manual or automatic, and say whether they'd prefer a male or a female instructor.

say: Then they see you, with your prices, your car, and your reviews. They can book a single lesson, a block of hours, or an intensive course.
cap: Then they see you, with your prices, your car, and your reviews. They can book a single lesson, a block of hours, or an intensive course.

say: They pick a free time, straight from your live diary, and pay online there and then. There's no booking fee for the learner, so your price is the price they see.
cap: They pick a free time, straight from your live diary, and pay online there and then. There's no booking fee for the learner, so your price is the price they see.

say: You set your own hourly rate, for manual, for automatic, or for both. You choose the discount you give on block bookings, and the price of any intensive course you offer.

say: You set your working hours once, with the gap you need between lessons, and how much notice you want. If you're on holiday, or teaching your own pupils, you block the time out, and nobody can book over it.

say: Every lesson drops straight into your diary, with the learner's name, their phone number, and the pick-up address. You can add a lesson for a learner yourself, and move one when you've both agreed a new time.
